intro: A grandmaster resigned in a winning position, left the hall, and never played again. His scoresheet was not a game at all.
echo: Any move at all will lose, and passing is not allowed.

meta.title: Meta: The Endgame Study
meta.flavor: Nothing reached the tournament hall undamaged. The damage, though, was remarkably consistent.
hints: Did every answer come out clean the first time? Each had exactly one wrong letter. Did you keep them?
